hook.text: Lottery winners and accident survivors return to baseline happiness within a year.

buildup.text: Impact bias: we overestimate how long and how intensely future events will affect our emotional state.

discovery.text: Gilbert and Wilson call it affective forecasting failure. We imagine future joy or pain as permanent.

twist.text: This bias fuels bad trades. We chase promotions expecting lasting happiness and dread failures expecting lasting pain.

climax.text: Before making a fear-based or desire-based decision, remember: you'll adapt. The feeling will be shorter than you think.

punchline.text: Nothing feels as long as you think it will.

quiz.question: What does impact bias cause us to do?
options: Overestimate how long future events will affect our feelings
